mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative earnings expectations and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock regime defined by industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising input costs and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction (HOUST) above 1400.0 thousand units signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and nonfarm payrolls declines from prior month indicate labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), strong consumer demand (RSAFS) drives corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.
